title: AI for Science with GPT-6 Astra: Thermal Design and Electrothermal Analysis of 2D CFET
abstract: arXiv:2609.17123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Thermal optimization of 2D CFET inverters requires testing structural proposals against their electrical costs. We examine these research tasks using an AI agent workflow within a supplied electrothermal model. At 12 nm, Astra selects a redistributed source-interconnect geometry, while a coordinating agent proposes a substrate-directed heat-removal path. The combined design reduces peak temperature rise by 1.67 K at fixed metal volume and 20 {\mu}W. A subsequent metal-resistance sensitivity gives about 0.6-K inverter cooling alongside a 2% nFET on-current loss. Effective contact-length scaling further shows that lower temperature can accompany higher thermal resistance when current falls. Reproduction identifies agreeing implementations and retains a 104.95-K failure for diagnosis. These results show that an AI scientist workflow can propose thermal structures, test them under common constraints, and quantify their electrical cost.

translated_title: 使用GPT-6 Astra的AI科学研究：二维CFET的热设计与电热分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.17123v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：二维CFET（互补场效应晶体管）反相器的热优化需要将结构方案与其电气代价进行权衡测试。我们在所提供的电热模型中使用AI智能体工作流来研究这些科研任务。在12纳米节点下，Astra选择了一种重新分布的源极互连几何结构，同时一个协调智能体提出了一种基板导向的散热路径。该组合设计在固定金属体积和20微瓦功耗的条件下将峰值温升降低了1.67 K。随后的金属电阻敏感性分析表明，以nFET导通电流损失2%为代价可获得约0.6 K的反相器降温。有效的接触长度缩放进一步表明，当电流下降时，更低的温度可以伴随更高的热阻出现。复现过程识别出结果一致的实施方案，并保留了一个104.95 K的故障案例用于诊断。这些结果表明，AI科学家工作流能够提出热结构方案、在共同约束下进行测试，并量化其电气代价。
tldr: 本文展示了基于GPT-6 Astra的AI科学家工作流能够自主提出二维CFET反相器的散热结构设计方案，在固定约束下完成电热测试并量化其电气代价，在固定金属体积和20微瓦功耗下实现峰值温升降低1.67 K。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that a GPT-6 Astra-based AI scientist workflow can autonomously propose thermal structure designs for 2D CFET inverters, test them under common electrothermal constraints, and quantify their electrical cost, achieving a 1.67 K reduction in peak temperature rise at fixed metal volume and 20 μW.
